messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High error rate and sustained token QPS spike observed against Dedicated pool 'dedicated-eu-west-1'. Autoscaler failing to reach target capacity within expected window. Automated mitigations triggered: limited. Paging on-call.
Maya (oncall): I'm on it — seeing 5xx increase and long queue times for long-context workloads. Dashboard shows scale-up events delayed ~90s beyond our SLO.
Jamal (sre): Logs show many concurrent requests with large sequence lengths from a handful of tenants. Suggest throttle non-enterprise traffic and enable burst capacity toggle for pool.
Sophie (prodops): Agreed. Can we identify top 5 tenants by QPS? We should notify CS for any paying customers impacted.
Alex R (dedicated): Pulling tenant QPS now. Top sources: tenant-42 (fintech), tenant-81 (ad platform), tenant-17 (analytics), and a bunch of small tenants spiking. Burst capacity currently at 0. Manual toggle available in infra-console.
Maya (oncall): Action plan: 1) Enable burst capacity +20% for dedicated-eu-west-1, 2) Temporarily apply stricter rate limit for non-enterprise plan, 3) lower autoscale cooldown to 30s, 4) monitor metrics for 10min and reopen if no improvement. Any objections?
Jamal (sre): No objections. Prepare command snippets.
Maya (oncall): Running toggle now:```bash
infra-console toggle-burst --pool dedicated-eu-west-1 --delta 20 --reason "oncall surge mitigation 1948001234"
```
Maya (oncall): Toggle sent — infra-console: accepted, request id req-0a1b2c.
Alex R (dedicated): Confirmed at infra layer: burst capacity +20% queued and activating. Start time ~now. Also changing autoscaler cooldown:```json
{"pool":"dedicated-eu-west-1","scale_up_cooldown_s":30}
```
Alex R (dedicated): Autoscaler config updated.
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Incident #INC-1948001 acknowledged by Maya (oncall).
Customer Success: Noted. We'll message CS reps for tenant-42 and tenant-81 and elevate if SLA risk. Any customer-visible degradations to call out?
Maya (oncall): Short answer: increased latency and intermittent 503s for large-context generation. Impact mostly non-enterprise, but tenant-42 is experiencing some failed requests. We should offer remediation and ETA.
Jamal (sre): Applying temporary rate limit rule to low-tier plans:```yaml
rule: "dedicated-eu-west-1/temporary-surge-1948001234"
match: plan: [basic, free]
limit: 60 r/s per tenant
window: 60s
action: 429
reason: "temporary surge mitigation"
```
Jamal (sre): Rule pushed, WAF acknowledged.
Alex R (dedicated): Pool metrics are improving — queue length down 40%, 5xxs dropping. Burst capacity is active.
Maya (oncall): Good. Sophie, can you coordinate CS messages? Use the template "We observed transient errors; mitigation applied; investigating root cause; ETA 30m".
Sophie (prodops): On it. Pinged account owners for tenant-42 and tenant-81, opened internal ticket TKT-19480042.
Customer Success: We sent tenant-42 a proactive note offering assisted retries and a dedicated support thread.
Maya (oncall): Monitoring for 10 more minutes. If stable, we'll lift rate limit for basic plan partially (80 r/s) and keep burst toggle until traffic normalizes.
Jamal (sre): Also dumping slow-request samples for postmortem. Saving top 50 traces:```text
/var/logs/requests/samples-1948001234.log
```
Maya (oncall): Trace samples saved. Please include in the incident timeline.
Alex R (dedicated): FYI turning on a temporary routing fallback for long-context model variant to a lighter model (compatible but lower context) for non-paid tiers to reduce memory pressure. Doing now.
Maya (oncall): Nice. Any immediate customer escalations?
Customer Success: tenant-42 replied: they saw 5 failures but accept live mitigation. Requested postmortem.
Jamal (sre): Metrics look stable for ~8 minutes, but there's a secondary micro-spike from tenant-17. I recommend keeping burst +20% and keeping the stricter rate limit for another 15 mins.
Maya (oncall): Agreed. Extending window. Updating incident note: mitigation extended.
pagerduty-bot: Reminder: On-call handoff in 35 minutes.
Maya (oncall): I'll prepare a handoff summary. If things hold for 15 mins, we'll consider de-escalating to monitoring.
Sophie (prodops): Drafting handoff note and adding runbook steps we executed.
Maya (oncall): Handoff summary (for next oncall): 1) Burst +20% enabled on dedicated-eu-west-1 (req-0a1b2c), 2) Autoscale cooldown set to 30s, 3) Temporary rate-limit rule applied to basic/free, id rule-ded-eu-1948001234, 4) Long-context routing fallback for non-paid tiers active, 5) CS notified tenants 42 & 81, 6) Artifacts: samples at /var/logs/requests/samples-1948001234.log and ticket TKT-19480042.
Maya (oncall): Handing off to Jamal in 20. If you take it, Jamal, please ack and continue monitoring.
Jamal (sre): Acked. I'll take after the handoff and keep the mitigation until 15:30UTC or until stable for 20m.
Maya (oncall): Thanks team — I'll sign out after I post to #incidents and update the PD incident.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations active — burst +20%, rate limiting in place, autoscale cooldown reduced. Next update scheduled in 15m.
Maya (oncall): Posted summary to #incidents. Leaving now, handoff to Jamal. :wave:
